name: CFPB stížnosti (300)
about: Stížnosti spotřebitelů z databáze amerického úřadu CFPB (Consumer Complaint Database), anglicky: 50 stížností z každého ze šesti finančních produktů; úkolem je poznat, kterého produktu se stížnost týká. Text je zkrácený nejvýš na 1200 znaků a předmět je u všech stejný. Úřad osobní údaje nahrazuje znaky XXXX. Původ textů: kopie databáze na Hugging Face (BEE-spoke-data/consumer-finance-complaints), stažená z úřadu v únoru 2024, CC0 podle karty kopie; úřad sám texty stížností přes své rozhraní dnes nevydává. Vzorek byl z kopie stažen 2026-10-06.
about_en: Consumer complaints from the database of the US agency CFPB (Consumer Complaint Database), in English: 50 complaints for each of the six financial products; the task is to recognize which product the complaint is about. The text is shortened to at most 1200 characters and the subject is the same for all of them. The agency replaces personal data with the characters XXXX. Origin of the texts: a copy of the database on Hugging Face (BEE-spoke-data/consumer-finance-complaints), downloaded from the agency in February 2024, CC0 according to the card of the copy; the agency itself does not release the complaint texts through its API today. fetch_datasets.py downloaded the sample from the copy on 2026-10-06.
license: CC0 1.0 (podle karty kopie na Hugging Face: cc0-1.0)
instructions: Classify the consumer complaint by the financial product it is about. Choose exactly one category.

categories.label: Hypotéka
categories.description: Home mortgage: applying for, servicing or paying a loan secured by a house, escrow, foreclosure.

categories.label: Kreditní karta
categories.description: Credit card: charges, fees, interest, billing disputes or closing of a credit card account.

categories.label: Běžný nebo spořicí účet
categories.description: Checking or savings account: deposits, withdrawals, overdraft fees, opening or closing a bank account.

categories.label: Studentská půjčka
categories.description: Student loan: federal or private loans for education, their servicing and repayment.

categories.label: Auto na úvěr nebo leasing
categories.description: Vehicle loan or lease: financing or leasing a car or another vehicle, repossession.

categories.label: Vymáhání dluhů
categories.description: Debt collection: a collector contacting the consumer about a debt, including debts the consumer says are not owed.
